title: QUAYSHIFT
summary: Build the town. Let the ferry through. Rebuild a miniature canal town from eight architectural pieces, then guide its ferry through two high bridges while avoiding the low arch. Includes three spatial challenges.
challenge_target_shortfall: Three edited starter challenges delivered; the aspirational 24-card collection is not complete.
part_markings: Architectural IDs A-H in the instructions map to lowercase STEP occurrence names a-h.
